response.rationale: The order has not yet been delivered (status "processing", days_since_delivery is null) and is not a final-sale item. No final-sale (RET-012), defective (RET-020), goodwill (RET-050), or fraud-hold (RET-051) rules apply. Since the item is a non-final-sale apparel item still within/before the standard 30-day window (delivery has not occurred, so it is not past 30 days), RET-007 applies and the return is eligible. The customer's stated reason (no longer needed) does not affect eligibility.
